name: Lead Engine
northStar: The dealing screen — a market terminal's grammar applied to local prospecting, where the live feed and your book are different materials.

ground.note: The field. Dark chosen from the use scene: one operator, desk, evening sessions.

raise.note: Hover fills and skeleton bars only.

rule.note: The structural element of this system.

ink-ghost.note: NON-TEXT ONLY. Fails AA by design; borders and rules only.

signal.note: The only accent. Primary action, focus, active surface, the book.

alert.note: Failure and destructive intent. Never decoration.

data.note: tabular-nums and slashed zero forced. Monospace for measurement, never as a technical costume.

label.note: Sets no colour on purpose so callers own it and it never fights an active state on specificity.

elevation.note: Depth is ground -> panel -> raise separated by 1px rules. A shadow anywhere is a defect.

exceptions.masthead: position: sticky; background: ground/95%; backdrop-filter: blur(2px)

motion.philosophy: One authored moment, not scattered effects. Everything starts already visible.
motion.tick-in: A new row on the feed flashes 18% signal on its ground and settles — the way a quote ticks. Not a slide-in.
motion.reducedMotion: All animation and transition collapsed to 0.01ms under prefers-reduced-motion.

focus.note: One treatment everywhere. The product is keyboard-first.

breakpoints.strategy: Desktop-primary, phone-tolerant. Below md the wordmark, key hints and provenance sentence drop out in that order. The provenance dot, surface label and record count never drop.

keyboard.note: Alt-modified deliberately, so plain digits stay free for filter and search fields.

icons.note: Emoji and Unicode glyphs are not an icon system.

scrollbars.note: color-scheme: dark so native controls follow the world.

rules: Nothing is rounded; radius-none is the only radius token.
ink-ghost is never used for text.
Content is edge to edge; only prose blocks are measured (46-52ch).
Structure with rules, not containers. No cards.
Every data surface states its provenance and the age of its data.
A saved lead and a search result must never look alike.
antiReferences: CRM dashboards covered in donut charts
